tests.memory_style_visual_description: Images, text, colors, and shapes are important to you. You remember information by seeing it. Paper, charts, tables, and colors help you.

tests.temperament_desc_choleric_ext: Energetic, fast, with strong leadership traits, but sometimes impatient. Active even under stress.
tests.temperament_desc_sanguine_ext: Social, cheerful, and positive. Adapts quickly and enjoys new things, but may struggle with consistency.
tests.temperament_desc_phlegmatic_ext: Stable, thoughtful, and calm. Slow but reliable. Cool-headed under stress.
tests.temperament_desc_melancholic_ext: Sensitive and emotional, deeply immersed in inner feelings. Strongly feels others' emotions.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Answers to your questions are here

faq_items.question: How long does it take to learn English from scratch?
faq_items.answer: It depends on the student's level, time devoted to classes, and individual abilities. Usually, with daily practice, noticeable results can be achieved within 6-12 months.

faq_items.question: What format are the lessons in?
faq_items.answer: Courses can be in offline and online format. Classes include speaking, writing, listening and grammar exercises.

faq_items.question: Who teaches at the study center?
faq_items.answer: Taught by our teachers with international certificates like IELTS 8.0-8.5, TESOL/TEFL, CELTA and average experience of over 5 years.

faq_items.question: How to register for classes?
faq_items.answer: You can register by visiting the center or by filling out an online form.

faq_items.question: How many people are in the groups?
faq_items.answer: Our classes have up to 12 students

faq_items.question: Can I start from beginner level?
faq_items.answer: Yes, courses are adapted for all levels and you can start from beginner level.

faq_items.question: What age can enroll in courses?
faq_items.answer: Our courses are open from age 8 to 30.

join_team.faq_subtitle: Answers to your questions are here

faq_items.question: What is the work schedule?
faq_items.answer: We offer work in two shifts. 08:00 - 14:00 and 14:00 - 20:00.

faq_items.question: Is there a trial period?
faq_items.answer: Yes, of course. Depending on position, it can be 1 to 2 weeks, 1 to 2 months.

faq_items.question: Will you hire without work experience?
faq_items.answer: Unfortunately, no. Depending on position, 6 months to 2 years of experience may be required.

faq_items.question: Are there trainings and courses during work?
faq_items.answer: Yes, of course. We organize team spirit training 4 times a year. Top managers receive skills enhancement courses.

faq_items.question: Is vacation given?
faq_items.answer: Annual vacation up to 20 days may be given.

faq_items.question: Is flexible schedule available?
faq_items.answer: It depends on position. Marketing team has flexible schedules. Other positions have fixed hours.
